name: Jund
description: Jund is one of the five shards of Alara, a brutal volcanic world of jungles and tar pits where dragons dominate a creature-eat-creature food chain.

description_citations.text: "Jund's One Rule". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Dec 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

summary.text: Jund is one of the five shards of Alara, a brutal volcanic world of jungles and tar pits where dragons dominate a creature-eat-creature food chain.

citations.text: "Jund". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Jund's One Rule". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Dec 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: Its single rule is that the strong survive, and its human war clans live by Life Hunts alongside goblins, viashino and dragons at the top of the food chain.

citations.text: "Jund's One Rule". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Dec 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.
"Shards of Alara in Italics". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: Ajani made his first planeswalk to Jund and met Sarkhan Vol, who taught him red magic.

citations.text: "Ajani: Faces of a Planeswalker". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Oct 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: Nicol Bolas recruited the shaman Rakka Mar and used her influence to promote greater Life Hunts, preparing the war clans for war with other shards.

citations.text: "Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Bolas's Secret Minions". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: She betrayed the Jundian hunters and presented Bolas to Sarkhan, and Ajani later killed her with a bolt of rage.

citations.text: "Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the Conflux, Jund's goblins and landwurms spilled into neighboring shards and Grixis overlaid parts of Jund, while the Conflux flooded it with blue and white mana that made its creatures less violent.

citations.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citations.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.
"Jund", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Jund", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Sarkhan ultimately sided with Bolas, leaving Jund without a planeswalker hero.

citations.text: "Nicol Bolas, Archenemy". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.
"Sarkhan Vol". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Meren, a Nel Toth apprentice shaman who survived the Dreamfire Draught trial with necromancy, killed her clan's shaman Kael and vowed to topple all the cairns of Jund.

citations.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.
"All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.
"All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

bio.text: Alara was later struck at Bant, Esper and Jund as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion.

citations.text: "Jund", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Jund is part of the reconverged Alara and was struck in the New Phyrexian Invasion, with the material saying no more about its outcome.

citations.text: "Jund", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas lures Rakka Mar with the promise of more magical power, and she uses her influence among Jund's human war clans to promote greater Life Hunts.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas saw the potential in Rakka Mar immediately and lured her with the promise of more magical power.

citation.text: "Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakka Mar gains dark powers of elementalism from her bond with Bolas.
timeline.quote: In return, Rakka gained dark powers of elementalism the likes of which she had never felt before.

citation.text: "Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakka convinces Kresh and his clan to hunt a hellkite; on the way her stone elementals defeat attacking viashino, and they meet Sarkhan Vol.
timeline.quote: They also caught up with Sarkhan Vol , who offered his aid in confronting the dragon.

citation.text: "Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the dragon's lair Rakka betrays the Jundians, using them as bait while she reveals Jund's Obelisk.
timeline.quote: Rakka betrayed the Jundians and used them as bait while she revealed Jund's Obelisk

citation.text: "Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakka saves Sarkhan Vol and presents her master Nicol Bolas to him.
timeline.quote: Later, she saved Sarkhan Vol and presented to him her master, Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani and Kresh's clan seek out Rakka for information about Bolas; she nearly kills Kresh with thunder-like energy.
timeline.quote: Rakka almost killed Kresh with powerful thunder-like energy

citation.text: "Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani, tempted by her offer, kills Rakka Mar with a bolt of rage.
timeline.quote: Ajani was tempted by this offering but ultimately killed Rakka with a mighty bolt of rage.

citation.text: "Rakka Mar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol praises the dragon as a marriage of power and will.
timeline.quote: The dragon is a perfect marriage of power and the will to use it.

citation.text: Crucible of Fire (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rakka Mar warns Jund is a wounded world whose searing blood spills out.
timeline.quote: Jund is a wounded world.

citation.text: Magma Spray (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rakka Mar warns of ancient thrashes lingering in shadow.
timeline.quote: Thrashes of the ancient past still linger in spirit and shadow

citation.text: Vicious Shadows (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Old dying dragons throw themselves into volcanoes, causing disaster.
timeline.quote: Old, dying dragons throw themselves into volcanoes, causing massive upheaval and widespread disaster.

citation.text: Volcanic Submersion (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Frozen goblins are eaten by a dragon's diving mate.
timeline.quote: Frozen in fear, the goblins stared upward at the circling hunter

citation.text: Broodmate Dragon (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol calls the dragon hunger, heat and need without pretense.
timeline.quote: The dragon has no pretense of compassion, no false mask of civilization

citation.text: Hellkite Overlord (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Half of the Riftclan Tol Breot is transported to Grixis during the Conflux.
timeline.quote: Half the clan was transported to Grixis during the Conflux .

citation.text: "Human", section "Jund". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Conflux, Grixis captures the Bloodhall and overlays the Eternal Crags, which crumble to dust.
timeline.quote: Captured by Grixis during the Conflux

citation.text: "Jund", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Half of Riftclan Tol Breot is transported to Grixis during the Conflux.
timeline.quote: Half the clan was transported to Grixis during the Conflux

citation.text: "Jund", section "Known clans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani makes his first planeswalk, to the shard of Jund, and meets Sarkhan Vol, who teaches him red magic to express his rage.
timeline.quote: On Jund Ajani met the planeswalker Sarkhan Vol

citation.text: "Ajani: Faces of a Planeswalker". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Oct 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The column describes the single rule of Jund, that the strong survive, with no hierarchy, planar quest, riddles or prophecies.
timeline.quote: The strong survive.

citation.text: "Jund's One Rule". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Dec 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jund's warriors keep only what they can carry, and weave trophies of past kills into their hair.
timeline.quote: Many of Jund's human warriors weave trophies of past kills into their hair

citation.text: "Jund's One Rule". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Dec 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The column imagines a Jund inhabitant's sudden death: devoured by a plant, a hellion, goblin raiders, or a hellkite feeding on a clan.
timeline.quote: Maybe a hellkite decides it's tired of goblin meat, and strafes your valley from above, and then gorges itself on the charred remains of your clan.

citation.text: "Jund's One Rule". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Dec 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Conflux merges the shards and Bant castles and Jund tar pits intrude on Naya; Mayael is powerless to stop it.
timeline.quote: By the time Bant castles and Jund tar pits intruded in her verdant paradise, Mayael was powerless to stop it.

citation.text: "The Soul of the World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Rakka Mar drifts from clan to clan offering elemental summoning, enduring many Life Hunts.
timeline.quote: Rakka Mar has drifted from clan to clan of human warriors

citation.text: "Bolas's Secret Minions". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas recruits Rakka Mar as a minion.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas saw the potential in Rakka Mar immediately.

citation.text: "Bolas's Secret Minions". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bolas uses Rakka's influence to promote greater Life Hunts, preparing the war-clans for war with other shards once the Conflux begins.
timeline.quote: Bolas has used Rakka's influence among the human war-clans to promote even greater and more dramatic Life Hunts

citation.text: "Bolas's Secret Minions". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Rakka Mar gains dark powers of elementalism in return.
timeline.quote: In return, Rakka has gained dark powers of elementalism

citation.text: "Bolas's Secret Minions". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Naya's elves, Nacatl and behemoths march to war with Bant and Jund, guided by Mayael's visions of Progenitus.
timeline.quote: Guided by the visions of the elvish prophet Mayael, the elves, the Nacatl, and the earthshaking behemoths of Naya march to war with its new neighbors.

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grixis's demons and undead swarm across the borders to feed on the life essence of the neighboring shards.
timeline.quote: the demons and undead horrors swarm into the adjacent borderlands like a plague, gorging on all the life essence they encounter.

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jund's goblins and landwurms spill into the neighboring shards and hellkites find new threats to their dominion.
timeline.quote: The goblin tribes of Jund began to explore the new lands

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The bones of Jund's dead resurface in Naya, poisoning the jungle and the sunseeders' crops.
timeline.quote: The bones of Jund's dead resurfaced in Naya, poisoning the jungle and killing the sunseeders' crops.

citation.text: Corrupted Roots (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The dead of Grixis catch the scent of life and follow it into Jund.
timeline.quote: The ripe smell of life drifted into Grixis.

citation.text: Zombie Outlander (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Goblins go to sleep in Jund and wake in Grixis facing zombies.
timeline.quote: The goblins went to sleep in Jund and awoke in Grixis.

citation.text: Unstable Frontier (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ajani arrives on Jund, where Sarkhan Vol advises him.
timeline.quote: Ajani found himself on Jund

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Alara unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Conflux floods Jund with blue and white mana, disrupting its food chain and making its creatures less violent and more thoughtful.
timeline.quote: When the Conflux occurred, blue and white mana flooded into Jund.

citation.text: "Jund", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Conflux the viashino of Jund confront their primitive counterparts on Naya.
timeline.quote: the Viashino of Jund were confronted by their primitive, beastly, counterparts on Naya

citation.text: "Viashino", section "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Grixis terrain bursts through Jund lava while Jund crags pierce Grixis necropolises.
timeline.quote: The dead terrain of Grixis would burst up through Jund's red-hot pools of lava, while the volcanic crags would pierce through Grixis's necropolises.

citation.text: "Incursion Zones". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Conflux strikes Jund, breaking the land with lava, raising black towers and sliding Jund into neighboring worlds.
timeline.quote: The lands of Jund sloughed off at the edges, sliding into new adjacent worlds

citation.text: "Circumnavigation". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The knight rides to rescue his clanmates but finds them floating, their souls seeping out.
timeline.quote: He found them floating in the air, their mortal souls seeping out of their bodies.

citation.text: "Circumnavigation". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zarratha's army invades Jund and harvests the clanmates' souls as fuel; the knight flees rather than charge.
timeline.quote: The souls of the knight's clanmates became fuel for the lich's undead forces, their vis harvested like mere wheat.

citation.text: "Circumnavigation". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Naya victims cringe as lava from Jund is brought down on their village.
timeline.quote: That's magical lava brought down on your little Naya village all the way from the encroaching plane of Jund

citation.text: "Magic Art Tropes". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ajani becomes a planeswalker in the comic Flight of the White Cat, in which Karrthus appears.
timeline.quote: the comic that explores how Ajani became a planeswalker

citation.text: "Jund's Trump Card". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Gernan observes once-devout rhoxes taking up arms with the savages of Jund.
timeline.quote: In this new world, I have seen the once-devout rhoxes take up arms with the savages of Jund.

citation.text: Rhox Brute (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol notes that many fools' chests burst trying to contain sangrite.
timeline.quote: Sangrite is the dragon's beating heart.

citation.text: Sangrite Backlash (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A Jund wurm makes itself at home in Naya, eating elves and leonin in place of goblins and viashino.
timeline.quote: A Jund wurm makes itself at home in the lush, green jungles and stone ruins of Naya.

citation.text: "Reality Check". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The power goes out and the narrator is suddenly transported into a dim cave, where a young girl tells him to keep quiet.
timeline.quote: I hit my head on something rough and hard, where only air should have been.

citation.work: A Different Kind of Origin Story
citation.text: "A Different Kind of Origin Story". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The narrator realizes he is in Jund with an elf child as a wurm thunders overhead.
timeline.quote: The cavern shook in time with a thunderous impact above.

citation.work: A Different Kind of Origin Story
citation.text: "A Different Kind of Origin Story". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The girl introduces herself as Eleni of the Knotvine tribe and asks the narrator, whom she takes for a wizard, to save them; his powers do not work without mana.
timeline.quote: "Eleni," she said. "Of the Knotvine tribe."

citation.work: A Different Kind of Origin Story
citation.text: "A Different Kind of Origin Story". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Eleni scrambles down a tunnel to find mana, and the narrator follows.
timeline.quote: But she was gone.

citation.work: A Different Kind of Origin Story
citation.text: "A Different Kind of Origin Story". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The ceiling collapses as the undead wurm plunges through, separating the narrator and Eleni.
timeline.quote: the thing was undead!

citation.work: A Different Kind of Origin Story
citation.text: "A Different Kind of Origin Story". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The narrator leaps the chasm toward the lava pool Eleni hopes will provide mana, and she helps pull him up.
timeline.quote: "Hurry," she said.

citation.work: A Different Kind of Origin Story
citation.text: "A Different Kind of Origin Story". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The wurm bursts up through the lava, draped in it, and charges them; the narrator falls onto a ledge and is trapped.
timeline.quote: I slipped.

citation.work: A Different Kind of Origin Story
citation.text: "A Different Kind of Origin Story". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Eleni refuses to abandon the trapped narrator.
timeline.quote: "I won't leave you!" she shouted.

citation.work: A Different Kind of Origin Story
citation.text: "A Different Kind of Origin Story". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The narrator tells Eleni to use the relic of Progenitus and she shouts a command word, disintegrating the wurm.
timeline.quote: The wurm disintegrated in a mass of smoking ash, billowing apart as the lava consumed it.

citation.work: A Different Kind of Origin Story
citation.text: "A Different Kind of Origin Story". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Eleni rescues the narrator, finds food and shelter, and negotiates with a human warrior-clan, becoming one of them.
timeline.quote: She was at home here.

citation.work: A Different Kind of Origin Story
citation.text: "A Different Kind of Origin Story". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bolas regenerates Tezzeret and sets him to find Crucius and etherium's secret, forcing compliance with Doctor Jest in his nervous system.
timeline.quote: Bolas grafted an entity named Doctor Jest into Tezzeret's nervous system, and so Tezzeret is forced to comply.

citation.text: "Test of Metal", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret awakes on Jund, restored by Bolas, who sends him to find Crucius.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret awoke on Jund, in the Worldheart Chalice

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Test of Metal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan Vol ultimately sides with Bolas, leaving Jund without a planeswalker hero.
timeline.quote: ultimately, Sarkhan sided with the mighty dragon.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas, Archenemy". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Flashback: on Jund Sarkhan finds the dragons magnificent but unworthy and fights alongside tribes hunting Malactoth.
timeline.quote: Old Malactoth— he had been a true challenge.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Meren, an apprentice shaman, is anointed by the Circle of Nel Toth with the Dreamfire Draught for her trial to become a full shaman.
timeline.quote: We of the Circle of Nel Toth anoint you, Meren, child of stone and blood and bone, with the Dreamfire Draught.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Meren drinks the vial and the poison begins to burn through her.
timeline.quote: She tilted the vial against her lips and drained it of its contents.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: In the present, Meren finishes unearthing an ancient weapon from the bog and names it Skaal Kesh, binding it to her with the thought of vengeance.
timeline.quote: You are Skaal Kesh . Unearthed and bound to me.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: In the trial, a massive elemental forms from the earth and the Circle chants as Meren must bind it while poison racks her body.
timeline.quote: Before her, coalescing from the earth, a massive elemental reared up.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Meren ambushes a Nel Toth hunting party, killing two warriors and the shaman and raising them as the Borrowed.
timeline.quote: The shaman rose from the ground and stood haltingly.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Meren forces the dead shaman to point the way to the clan's new convening caves and sets her Borrowed party marching.
timeline.quote: Where are the new convening caves of the Circle.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the elemental recoils from Meren's greeting, breaks her arm and ribs, and she shelters in a stone dome as it rages.
timeline.quote: As soon as she made contact, the elemental recoiled with a roar

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: dying, Meren hears the silence between the pulses of life magic and reaches into the darkness.
timeline.quote: She reached into the darkness, and pulled.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: green death fire erupts from Meren's shelter and annihilates the avalanche elemental before the astonished Circle, and she collapses.
timeline.quote: Nothing remained but a heap of broken rocks.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the Circle debates her fate and Kael declares she is no shaman and must be killed.
timeline.quote: We must kill her now.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the elder shaman stops the killing, ruling the trial continues until the draught is purged or she dies, and the Circle leaves her to die.
timeline.quote: Let her conclude the trial alone.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Kael tells Meren to die quietly and alone, and abandons her.
timeline.quote: Die, Meren. Die quiet and alone.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Meren survives by drawing on the void to quench the poison, heals, and leaves Jund's clans behind following the call of darkness.
timeline.quote: She did not die, for on that day, she wielded death itself.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Meren leads her Borrowed Ones into the Nel Toth camp, killing a young sentry and raising fallen shamans in a bloodbath.
timeline.quote: The result was a bloodbath.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Kael and two elders burn her ranks with fire and Kael challenges her as a death mage, not recognizing her until she lowers her shadow.
timeline.quote: Your rampage ends here, death mage!

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Meren kills the two elders, who shift into a bear and a thrinax, with fire and corruption, then reanimates them.
timeline.quote: Finally, it collapsed in a smoking heap at her feet.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Kael tells Meren she should have died, then calls three avalanche elementals against her, naming her Meren Deathbender.
timeline.quote: Return to the earth, Meren Deathbender.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Meren calls down Skaal Kesh, which destroys the elementals and impales Kael.
timeline.quote: An enormous, shadowy dragon crouched in his place, holding the broken form of Kael impaled on its claws.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Meren has Skaal Kesh devour Kael, completing her vengeance.
timeline.quote: Vengeance served.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Meren, last of Clan Nel Toth, vows to topple all the cairns of Jund.
timeline.quote: And she would not stop until all of the cairns of Jund were toppled.

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Alara is struck at Bant, Esper and Jund as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion with a simultaneous strike on Bant, Esper, and Jund.

citation.text: "Jund", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alara's five shards converge into one plane flowing with all five colors of mana.
timeline.quote: But now they have converged into one, and the rejoined plane flows with all five colors of mana once more.

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As the boundaries dissolve, cultures clash and wars break out between the shards.
timeline.quote: As the boundaries between the shards dissolve, cultures clash and wars ensue.

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After losing nearly all of the Eleventh Legion, Dollun emerges in tribal garb with two spiked maces, butchers Naya and Jund enemies, and escapes into a Jund chasm.
timeline.quote: he escaped into one of the lowland chasms of Jund

citation.text: "Dollun Spinebreaker", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Meren is forced to drink the Dreamfire Draught and face an elemental; she destroys it using necromancy.
timeline.quote: destroyed the elemental using what she would eventually learn to be necromancy

citation.text: "Meren", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The elders deem her dangerous, let her fight the Draught, and she survives and leaves the clan for Grixis.
timeline.quote: Meren survived this, though, and left Clan Nel Toth

citation.text: "Meren", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Meren attacks her old home, killing most of its residents.
timeline.quote: she entered her old home and attacked it, killing most of the residents

citation.text: "Meren", section "Vengeance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Meren duels Kael and the dragon devours him; she resolves to topple Jund.
timeline.quote: she gestured to the dragon, which then devoured the man

citation.text: "Meren", section "Vengeance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
